claims: Yaxel Lendeborg’s parents are Yissel Raposo and Okary Lendeborg.
Yissel Raposo and Okary Lendeborg are former basketball players for the Dominican Republic national team.
Yissel Raposo is currently battling cancer.
Yissel Raposo is a former two-sport athlete (basketball and volleyball) in the Dominican Republic and the American University of Puerto Rico.
Yissel Raposo pushed Yaxel Lendeborg toward Junior College.
Yaxel Lendeborg had a 2026 NCAA tournament run.
Yissel Raposo frequently supported Yaxel Lendeborg during his 2026 NCAA tournament run.
Yissel Raposo has a cancer diagnosis.
Yaxel Lendeborg's family moved from Puerto Rico to Pennsauken Township, New Jersey.
Yissel Raposo served as Yaxel Lendeborg's primary mentor.
Yaxel Lendeborg has described his mother as the "strongest woman" he knows.
Yaxel Lendeborg told The Players' Tribune that his mother "saved [his] life" when he was struggling to find his path.
